rationale:
`assets/skills/habeas-evidence/SKILL.md` is a bundled skill, since it has front matter with `name: habeas-evidence`. It is therefore a site of `requirements.cli.skill_conventions`.

The only obligation is that the description MUST state when to use the skill in terms of the user's task. The front-matter description does this:
- It opens with "Use when Habeas evidence needs creating or refreshing".
- It then names task situations: `habeas coverage` or `habeas status` reporting missing, stale, or false evidence, uncovered `{test}` lines, unmarked tests, FIXME judgments, and review or assessment disagreements.
- It also covers a user who only says "the habeas test is failing".

These are all things a user is trying to do or has hit, so the trigger is stated in task terms.

The description also says "If evidence went stale because code or requirements moved, use habeas-refactor first." The requirement allows this: a description MAY name another bundled skill where an agent could confuse the two. It adds no further obligation.

No violation matches were listed. I found no gap.
